study.title: Triple-negative breast cancer
study.tissue: CD45+ cells from paired tumor biopsies
study.scope: All cells retained in the 12-participant paired tumor-biopsy cohort processed with sctrial. The original study also profiled blood and additional participants.
study.annotation: sctrial grouped the authors’ published Table S2 RNA clusters by lineage. Unassigned and unresolved cells contribute to each capture denominator.
study.embedding: Joint UMAP of normalized RNA expression across the displayed cohort, computed by sctrial using 2,000 highly variable genes, 30 PCs and 15 neighbors.
study.expression: The arithmetic mean includes zeros. Each cell's RNA profile was normalized to 10,000 counts, then natural-log transformed with log1p.
study.pathway: The per-cell score averages normalized log1p expression of Reactome member genes retained in the expression matrix with equal gene weight.
study.histogram: 32 equal-width bins on each feature’s full scale across both visits and arms. The first bin includes zeros. The last includes the upper endpoint.
